top_signals.title: Ryan Howard on Sports Investing and MLB’s Labor Fight
top_signals.summary:
Ryan Howard spent more than a decade as one of baseball’s most feared hitters. Since retiring, he’s built an interesting second act as an entrepreneur and investor, with bets spanning everything from the “Topgolf of baseball” to youth sports and professional soccer.

In this episode of The Deal, Ryan tells Alex Rodriguez and Jason Kelly how he transitioned from playing baseball to investing in ventures like Batter Up that will help more people play baseball, why making deals can feel like playing baseball, and which issues he thinks could shape the labor fight between the MLB and the players' union. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Ministers to boost innovation in payments with new objective for Bank of England
top_signals.summary: The Government intends to give the Bank of England a new responsibility to support innovation in payment systems and emerging forms of digital money, whilst continuing to prioritise financial stability.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.summary: Privatisation has become associated with failures, such as in the water industry, rather than its successes
